title: Dreame L50 Ultra $956.80 with 20% off StoreCash Activation + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ The Good Guys
body:
Deal: Dreame L50 Ultra $956.80 with 20% off StoreCash Activation + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ The Good Guys

[noise36] Good robot and good price but I think my next robot will be one of the new single roller type mops which are starting to become common.
[Kliche] Oh man, just purchased the L40 Ultra AE during prime day
[gunnerz] Its a strange one right. I did the same and and i think its still not bad. Thisbis far better if you pets other wise maybe 10 to 15% better
[Kliche] Can never keep up with tech nowadays, I still haven't unboxed the L40 Ultra AE yet but probably would keep it as it is
[CheapScab] Mine tangled 4 times today during vacuuming
[MGMan] It's been very good and reliable so far. I bought it last December for $1120.
[SpaceNinja] Don't be misguided by the specs, features or reviews Roborock is still the best. I have both.
[noise36] Nah man top 10 is all dreame and ecovacs , roborock massively overrated by ozbargain
https://vacuumwars.com/vacuum-wars-best-robot-vacuums/
[jonoz] Agreed, switched based on reviews to Dreame and its horrible. Bought another Roborock 6 months after buying the Dreame.
[ChrisInMelbourne] My L40s Ultra just stopped being able to navigate after 7 months. :(
[jemusah] Mine had a constant mildew smell despite doing everything I could to fix it.
Sent it in for warranty repairs and when I chased up after 4 weeks they said they were waiting on parts from China. I managed to get a refund as JB dont sell it anymore, so will be looking at other brands
[chickenchipsgravy] Cleaning performance has been good but the mapping capability is a mystery, bloody thing roams around and goes to certain zones the most illogical way. I got it for 1200 at Xmas so this price is good
[CheapCookie] I have the AE model.
It randomly wanders my room sometimes…like it is looking for its soul….
[telby] The L10s I bought recently does the same thing. It goes off on wild adventures or spins in circles. And I’m thinking, what the hell is it supposed to be doing? But then it continues what it was doing. I still have the Xiaomi V1, I bought in 2017 and still runs perfect.
[Nathan165] Just returned this after 9 months. Couldn’t fault it when it worked, but refused to enter rooms with dark carpet.
[Redsin] Oh interesting. How did you manage to return it after 9 months? Where did you buy from?
[xyzed] Would have been under ACL - Not fit for purpose, does not do as advertised (vacuum carpets, unless they say it doesn't do dark carpets to begin with).
[Nathan165] Harvey Norman. Had to drop it back in after two “repairs” before they refunded.
[Redsin] Thanks. Really weird that it would not enter room with dark carpets
[Wombat808] Got this for $1088 last December. Still works great. App is easy to use. Can be set to detach mop pads at the base station or lift them upwards before going over carpets.
[Bargainboss99] My promo code says invalid promo code :(
[Bargainboss99] Nvm, to the morons doing the same thing as me it’s instore only
[razdi] I would recommend walking in to the store and asking for the best price. I got this for $850 last month. Great robot for the price.
